description: This is a test class for AcunetixOutputProcessor, designed to verify the processing of vulnerability reports generated by Acunetix scanner. It extends ParserTestCase and contains a method that tests parsing vulnerability data from an XML resource file.

classes.name: AcunetixOutputProcessorTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the AcunetixOutputProcessor's ability to parse vulnerability data from an XML report.

methods.name: testParsingVulnerabilities
methods.description: Tests the parsing of vulnerabilities from an Acunetix XML report, asserting that the number of vulnerabilities and specific vulnerability details are correctly extracted.
